```python
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Job data
jobs = {
    "0": {"processing_time": 57, "due_date": 187, "weight": 9},
    "1": {"processing_time": 30, "due_date": 341, "weight": 9},
    "2": {"processing_time": 11, "due_date": 563, "weight": 4},
    "3": {"processing_time": 43, "due_date": 485, "weight": 1},
    "4": {"processing_time": 95, "due_date": 587, "weight": 9},
    "5": {"processing_time": 26, "due_date": 449, "weight": 2},
    "6": {"processing_time": 5, "due_date": 156, "weight": 7},
    "7": {"processing_time": 99, "due_date": 549, "weight": 2},
    "8": {"processing_time": 39, "due_date": 114, "weight": 5},
    "9": {"processing_time": 13, "due_date": 156, "weight": 10},
    "10": {"processing_time": 26, "due_date": 642, "weight": 5},
    "11": {"processing_time": 71, "due_date": 222, "weight": 5},
    "12": {"processing_time": 62, "due_date": 575, "weight": 6},
    "13": {"processing_time": 1, "due_date": 225, "weight": 5},
    "14": {"processing_time": 70, "due_date": 314, "weight": 4},
    "15": {"processing_time": 50, "due_date": 178, "weight": 9},
    "16": {"processing_time": 32, "due_date": 265, "weight": 9},
    "17": {"processing_time": 94, "due_date": 671, "weight": 4},
    "18": {"processing_time": 97, "due_date": 480, "weight": 4},
    "19": {"processing_time": 29, "due_date": 110, "weight": 3},
    "20": {"processing_time": 26, "due_date": 487, "weight": 3},
    "21": {"processing_time": 23, "due_date": 390, "weight": 6},
    "22": {"processing_time": 13, "due_date": 456, "weight": 2},
    "23": {"processing_time": 32, "due_date": 444, "weight": 6},
    "24": {"processing_time": 28, "due_date": 145, "weight": 9}
}

# Create a new model
model = gp.Model("single_machine_scheduling")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Number of jobs
n = len(jobs)

# Add variables
C = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="C")  # Completion times
T = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="T")  # Tardiness
x = model.addVars(n, n, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")   # Sequencing variables

# Set objective: Minimize weighted sum of tardiness
model.setObjective(gp.quicksum(jobs[str(j)]["weight"] * T[j] for j in range(n)), GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Add constraints
# Completion time constraints
for j in range(n):
    model.addConstr(C[j] >= jobs[str(j)]["processing_time"] + gp.quicksum(jobs[str(i)]["processing_time"] * x[i, j] for i in range(n) if i != j))

# Tardiness constraints
for j in range(n):
    model.addConstr(T[j] >= C[j] - jobs[str(j)]["due_date"])

# Sequencing constraints
for i in range(n):
    model.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for j in range(n) if i != j) == 1)
    model.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[j, i] for j in range(n) if i != j) == 1)

# Solve the model
model.optimize()

# Extract the sequence
sequence = sorted(range(n), key=lambda j: C[j].X)

# Calculate the objective value
objective_value = model.ObjVal

# Output the result
import json
result = {"sequence": sequence, "objective_value": objective_value}
print(json.dumps(result))
```
